items.guidance: serve.py and wsgi.py look like development entry points; first check which command the Dockerfile CMD or entrypoint uses to start the app on port 8000. If production uses a WSGI server such as gunicorn with a bind option, set that bind to 0.0.0.0:8000 in the Dockerfile and leave serve.py and wsgi.py unchanged. Change those files only if the image actually starts through them.
